description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate plaintext credentials in the KYC service to Azure Key Vault.
tasks.reason: Hardcoded credentials are present and should be replaced with centralized secret management.
tasks.requirements: Migrate hardcoded credentials from application properties to Azure Key Vault-based retrieval using managed identity. Addresses issues: CWE-259: Use of Hard-coded Password, CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities.
tasks.reason: Mandatory vulnerabilities were identified in project dependencies and must be remediated before deployment.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to minimum patched versions and validate build/test outcomes after remediation. Addresses issues: CVE-2023-5072: Java: DoS Vulnerability in JSON-JAVA, CVE-2022-45688: json stack overflow vulnerability.

tasks.description: Containerize and deploy the KYC service to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: A cloud deployment target is required to complete modernization to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps using existing/new resources and managed identity authentication.
